description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Writes a batch of draft calls to action for the confirmed offers, claims-checked against where they point. Charges Embers once per call (refunded when nothing usable comes back). Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/hook-studio/ctas/generate.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

destination.description: An https link every CTA may point at, or `bio` for link in bio.

name: ctas_generate
title: Generate CTAs (Hook Studio step 4)
